sentences.zh: 食貨志

translations.literal: Treatise on Food and Commodities
translations.idiomatic: Treatise on Finance and Economics

sentences.zh: 〈（案：《薛史·食貨志序》，原本闕佚，卷中惟鹽法載之較詳，其田賦、雜稅諸門，僅存大略，疑明初薛史已有殘闕也。

translations.literal: (Note: The preface to the Treatise on Food and Commodities in the History of Xue is missing in the original. In this scroll only the salt laws are recorded in relative detail; the sections on land tax and miscellaneous levies preserve only outlines. It is suspected that the History of Xue was already defective in the early Ming.)
translations.idiomatic: (Editorial note: The preface to the Treatise on Finance and Economics in the History of Xue was already lost in the source text. Within this chapter only salt regulations are treated at length; the sections on land tax and miscellaneous levies survive only in outline. It is likely that the History of Xue was already incomplete by the early Ming.)

sentences.zh: 今無可采補，姑存其舊。）〉

translations.literal: Now there is nothing that can be gathered to supplement it; for the present the old text is preserved as it stands.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Nothing further can be recovered to fill the gap, so the received text is left as it stands.)〉

sentences.zh: 梁祖之開國也，屬黃巢大亂之後。

translations.literal: When the founding emperor of Liang established the state, it fell in the period after Huang Chao's great rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When the Liang founding emperor established his dynasty, the realm was still reeling from Huang Chao's great rebellion.

sentences.zh: 以夷門一鎮，外嚴烽侯，內辟汙萊，厲以耕桑，薄以租賦，士雖苦戰，民則樂輸，二紀之間，俄成霸業。

translations.literal: With a single prefecture at Yimen, outwardly he tightened beacon and frontier defense, inwardly he opened wasteland and marshes, urged farming and sericulture, and kept rents and levies light; though the warriors suffered in battle, the people gladly paid taxes, and within two twenty-year cycles he swiftly achieved hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: From the single stronghold of Yimen he tightened frontier defenses abroad and reclaimed wasteland at home, promoted farming and silk production, and kept rents and levies light. Soldiers bore the hardships of war, but the people paid their dues willingly; within two twenty-year cycles he had built a hegemonic power almost overnight.

sentences.zh: 及末帝與莊宗對壘於河上，河南之民，雖困於輦運，亦未至流亡，其義無他，蓋賦斂輕而丘園可戀故也。

translations.literal: When the last emperor of Liang and Emperor Zhuangzong faced each other in stalemate on the Yellow River, the people of Henan, though worn down by cart transport levies, still did not flee into exile; the reason was none other than that tax collections were light and they could still cherish their homes and fields.
translations.idiomatic: When the last Liang emperor and Emperor Zhuangzong faced each other across the Yellow River, the people of Henan were strained by transport corvée, yet they did not take to flight—for no other reason than that levies remained light and they still had homes and fields worth holding on to.

sentences.zh: 及莊宗平定梁室，任吏人孔謙為租庸使，峻法以剝下，厚斂以奉上，民產雖竭，軍食尚虧。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong pacified the Liang house, he appointed the clerk Kong Qian as commissioner of land tax and corvée; with harsh laws he stripped those below, with heavy exactions he enriched those above, and though the people's wealth was exhausted, military provisions were still deficient.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Zhuangzong overthrew the Liang, he put the clerk Kong Qian in charge of land tax and corvée. Kong applied harsh laws to squeeze the populace and heavy exactions to fill the court's coffers; even when civilian wealth was drained dry, army rations still fell short.

sentences.zh: 加之以兵革，因之以饑饉，不三四年，以致顛隕，其義無他，蓋賦役重而寰區失望故也。

translations.literal: Added to this were warfare and famine; in less than three or four years he came to ruin. The reason was none other than that taxes and corvée were heavy and the whole realm lost hope.
translations.idiomatic: War and famine followed, and within three or four years the dynasty collapsed—for no other reason than that taxes and corvée had grown crushing and the empire had lost faith in the regime.

sentences.zh: 〈（案：以上見《容齋三筆》所引《薛史》，繹其文義，當系《食貨志序》，今錄於卷首。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: The foregoing appears in the History of Xue as quoted in Hong Mai's Third Collection of Rong Studio Notes. Interpreting its meaning, it should belong to the preface of the Treatise on Food and Commodities; it is now recorded at the head of the scroll.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Editorial note: The passage above is quoted from the History of Xue in Hong Mai's Third Collection of Rong Studio Notes. By its sense it belongs to the preface of the Treatise on Finance and Economics and is placed here at the opening of the chapter.)〉

sentences.zh: 唐同光三年二月，敕：「魏府小菉豆稅，每畝減放三升。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Tongguang of Tang, an edict stated: 'The tax on small green beans in Weifu is reduced by three sheng per mu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongguang 3 (925), an edict ordered: 'The tax on small green beans in the Wei prefecture circuit shall be reduced by three sheng per mu.

sentences.zh: 城內店宅園囿，比來無稅，頃因偽命，遂有配征。

translations.literal: Shops, residences, and gardens within the city have hitherto been untaxed; recently, because of a usurper's order, levies were assigned.
translations.idiomatic: Shops, houses, and gardens inside the city had long been untaxed, but a recent usurper's order imposed assigned levies on them.

sentences.zh: 後來以所征物色，添助軍裝衣賜，將令通濟，宜示矜蠲。

translations.literal: Later the goods collected were used to supplement military clothing and rewards, intending to make supplies flow smoothly; compassion and remission should be shown.
translations.idiomatic: The goods thus collected had been earmarked to supplement military clothing and rewards in the hope of easing supply; the court should now show clemency and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 今據緊慢去處，於見輸稅絲上，每兩作三等，酌量納錢，收市軍裝衣賜，其絲仍與除放。」

translations.literal: Now, according to whether places are congested or slack, on the silk already paid in tax, every two units shall be divided into three grades and an appropriate cash payment assessed, with which military clothing and rewards shall be purchased; the silk itself shall still be remitted.'
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, according to whether a locality is congested or slack, for every two units of silk already paid in tax, three graded cash payments shall be assessed as appropriate to purchase military clothing and rewards, while the silk itself shall be remitted.'

sentences.zh: 其年閏十二月，吏部尚書李琪上言：「請賦稅不以折納為事，一切以本色輸官，又不以紐配為名，止以正稅加納。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of that year, Li Qi, Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, submitted a memorial: 'I request that tax levies not rely on commutation, but that everything be delivered to the government in kind, and that there be no assessments under the name of supplementary allocation—only the regular tax with additional payment.'
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month of that year, Li Qi, Minister of Personnel, memorialized: 'Taxes should not be collected through commutation; everything should be delivered to the government in kind. Assessments should not be imposed under the name of supplementary allocation—only the regular tax with any lawful surcharge.'

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「本朝征科，惟配有兩稅，至於折納，當不施為。

translations.literal: An edict replied: 'In this dynasty's collections, only the two taxes may have supplementary allocation; as for commutation, it should not be applied.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: 'In this dynasty's collections, only the two taxes may carry supplementary allocation; commutation should not be used.

sentences.zh: 宜依李琪所論，應逐稅合納錢物斛斗鹽錢等，宜令租庸司指揮，並準元征本色輸納，不得改更，若合有移改，即須具事由聞奏。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow Li Qi's proposal: for all taxes due in cash, goods, grain measures, salt money, and the like, the Office of Land Tax and Corvée shall be ordered that all shall be paid in the originally levied kind and nothing altered; if any change is appropriate, the reasons must be reported in a memorial to the throne.'
translations.idiomatic: Li Qi's proposal is approved. For all taxes payable in cash, goods, grain, salt money, and the like, the Office of Land Tax and Corvée shall order payment in the originally levied kind with no alteration. Any change must be reported to the throne with full reasons.'

sentences.zh: 長興二年六月，敕：「委諸道觀察使，屬縣於每村定有力人戶充村長。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Changxing, an edict stated: 'Commission the circuit observation commissioners: in each county, for every village appoint a household of means to serve as village head.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Changxing 2 (931), an edict ordered: 'Circuit observation commissioners shall have each county appoint a household of means in every village to serve as village head.

sentences.zh: 與村人議，有力人戶出剩田苗，補貧下不迨，肯者即具狀征收，有辭者即排段檢括。

translations.literal: Together with the villagers they shall deliberate: households of means shall contribute surplus field seedlings to supply those among the poor who fall short; those willing shall draw up a statement for collection, and those who dispute shall have their holdings surveyed and checked.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the villagers they shall decide how prosperous households shall contribute surplus field seedlings to cover shortfalls among the poor. Those who agree shall submit statements for collection; those who object shall have their holdings surveyed and assessed.

sentences.zh: 自今年起為定額。

translations.literal: From this year onward this shall be a fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: From this year forward the arrangement shall be a fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 有經災沴及逐年逋處，不在此限。」

translations.literal: Places that have suffered disaster or calumny and places with annual arrears are not subject to this rule.'
translations.idiomatic: Areas stricken by disaster or with chronic arrears are exempt.'

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，三司奏請：「諸道上供稅物，充兵士衣賜不足。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year, the Three Departments memorialized: 'The tribute goods supplied by the circuits are insufficient for soldiers' clothing and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year, the Three Departments reported: 'Circuit tribute goods are insufficient to cover soldiers' clothing and rewards.

sentences.zh: 其天下所納斛斗及錢，除支贍外，請依時折納綾羅絹帛。」

translations.literal: Of the grain measures and cash paid in from the empire, beyond what is needed for disbursement, we request that they be commuted in timely fashion into damask, gauze, silk, and cloth.'
translations.idiomatic: Of the grain and cash paid in from across the realm, beyond what is needed for current disbursement, we ask that the remainder be commuted in timely fashion into damask, gauze, silk, and cloth.'

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 晉天福四年正月，敕：「應諸道節度刺史，不得擅加賦役及於縣邑別立監征。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Tianfu of Jin, an edict stated: 'All circuit military commissioners and prefectural governors must not on their own authority add taxes and corvée, nor establish separate collection offices in counties and towns.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jin Tianfu 4 (939), an edict declared: 'Circuit military commissioners and prefectural governors must not on their own authority add taxes and corvée or set up separate collection offices in counties and towns.

sentences.zh: 所納田租，委人戶自量自既。」

translations.literal: For field rent paid in, households shall measure and deliver it themselves.'
translations.idiomatic: Field rent shall be measured and delivered by the households themselves.'

sentences.zh: 周顯德三年十月，宣三司指揮諸道州府，今後夏稅，以六月一日起征，秋稅至十月一日起征，永為定制。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Xiande of Zhou, the Three Departments proclaimed to the circuits and prefectures: henceforth the summer tax shall be collected starting on the first day of the sixth month, and the autumn tax starting on the first day of the tenth month—this shall be the permanent regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Zhou Xiande 3 (956), the Three Departments ordered all circuits and prefectures that henceforth the summer tax would be collected from the first day of the sixth month and the autumn tax from the first day of the tenth month, as a permanent rule.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，賜諸道《均田圖》。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, the Diagram of Equalized Fields was bestowed on the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, the Diagram of Equalized Fields was distributed to all circuits.

sentences.zh: 十月，命左散騎常侍艾穎等三十四人，下諸州檢定民租。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, thirty-four persons including Ai Ying, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, were ordered down to the prefectures to verify civilian rents.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, thirty-four officials led by Ai Ying, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, were sent to the prefectures to verify civilian land rents.

sentences.zh: 周顯德六年春，諸道使臣回，總計檢到戶二百三十萬九千八百一十二。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year of Xiande of Zhou, when the circuit envoys returned, the total of households verified was 2,309,812.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Zhou Xiande 6 (959), when the circuit envoys returned, they reported a total of 2,309,812 households verified.

sentences.zh: 唐同光二年，度支奏請榜示府州縣鎮，軍民商旅凡有買賣，並須使八十陌錢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongguang of Tang, the Department of Revenue memorialized requesting that proclamations be posted in prefectures, counties, and market towns: in all buying and selling by soldiers, civilians, merchants, and travelers, eighty-percent strings of cash must be used.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongguang 2 (924), the Department of Revenue asked that notices be posted in prefectures, counties, and market towns requiring all military personnel, civilians, merchants, and travelers to use eighty-percent strings of cash in trade.

sentences.zh: 唐同光二年二月，詔曰：「錢者，古之泉布，蓋取其流行天下，布散人間，無積滯則交易通，多貯藏則士農困，故西漢興改幣之制，立告緡之條，所以權蓄賈而防大奸也。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, an edict stated: 'Cash is the ancient currency of spring and cloth, taking its name from circulating through the realm and spreading among the people. When nothing is hoarded, trade flows; when much is stored away, scholars and farmers suffer. Therefore the Western Han, at its rise, reformed the currency system and established the report-on-hoarding statute, thereby balancing stored wealth and guarding against great wrongdoing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongguang 2, an edict declared: 'Coin is the ancient currency called spring and cloth, named for circulating through the realm and spreading among the people. When nothing is hoarded, trade flows freely; when much is stored away, scholars and farmers suffer. That is why the Western Han, at its founding, reformed the currency and established the report-on-hoarding law—to balance stored wealth and check great fraud.

sentences.zh: 宜令所司散下州府，常須檢察，不得令富室分外收貯見錢，又工人銷鑄為銅器，兼沿邊州鎮設法鈐轄，勿令商人般載出境。」

translations.literal: The responsible offices shall be ordered to disseminate this to the prefectures and constantly inspect, not allowing wealthy houses to store cash beyond measure, nor workers to melt and cast it into copper vessels; along the frontier prefectures and garrisons methods of control shall be set up so that merchants are not allowed to transport it out of the border.'
translations.idiomatic: Responsible offices shall send orders to the prefectures for constant inspection: wealthy households must not hoard cash beyond measure, workers must not melt coin into copper vessels, and frontier prefectures and garrisons shall enforce controls so merchants cannot carry coin out of the realm.'

sentences.zh: 三月，知唐州晏駢安奏：「市肆間點檢錢帛，內有錫镴小錢，揀得不少，皆是江南綱商挾帶而來。」

translations.literal: In the third month, Yan Pian'an, prefect of Tangzhou, memorialized: 'In inspecting cash and cloth in the markets, among them are tin-and-lead small coins, and no small number have been found—all brought in concealed by Jiangnan convoy merchants.'
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yan Pian'an, prefect of Tangzhou, reported: 'Inspection of cash and cloth in the markets has turned up many tin-and-lead small coins, all smuggled in by Jiangnan convoy merchants.'

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「帛布之幣，雜以鉛錫，惟是江湖之外，盜鑄尤多，市肆之間，公行無畏，因是綱商挾帶，舟楫往來，換易好錢，藏貯富室，實為蠹弊，須有條流。

translations.literal: An edict stated: 'In cloth currency mixed with lead and tin, it is especially beyond the rivers and lakes that illicit casting is most frequent; in the markets they circulate openly without fear. Because of this, convoy merchants carry them in, boats come and go, good coin is exchanged away, and wealthy houses store it up—this is truly a destructive abuse and regulations are required.
translations.idiomatic: The throne replied: 'Debased coin mixed with lead and tin circulates most freely beyond the Yangzi region, where illicit minting is rampant and markets trade it openly without fear. Convoy merchants smuggle it in by boat, trade it for good coin, and wealthy houses hoard the proceeds—a serious abuse that demands regulation.

sentences.zh: 宜令京城、諸道，於坊市行使錢內，點檢雜惡鉛錫錢，並宜禁斷。

translations.literal: The capital and all circuits are ordered that in the cash used in wards and markets, mixed inferior lead-and-tin coin shall be inspected and all forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The capital and all circuits shall inspect cash used in wards and markets and prohibit all inferior lead-and-tin coin.

sentences.zh: 沿江州縣，每有舟船到岸，嚴加覺察，不許將雜鉛錫惡錢往來換易好錢，如有私載，並行收納。」

translations.literal: Along the river prefectures and counties, whenever boats reach shore, strict surveillance shall be applied; it is not permitted to exchange inferior lead-and-tin coin for good coin back and forth, and if any is privately carried, it shall all be confiscated.'
translations.idiomatic: Riverine prefectures and counties shall strictly watch every boat that reaches shore and forbid exchanging debased lead-and-tin coin for good coin; any privately carried debased coin shall be confiscated.'

sentences.zh: 天成元年八月，中書門下奏：「訪聞近日諸道州府所賣銅器價貴，多是銷熔見錢，以邀厚利。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Tiancheng, the Secretariat memorialized: 'We have learned that recently in the circuits and prefectures the copper vessels sold are costly, and most of this comes from melting current cash to seek thick profit.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tiancheng 1 (926), the Secretariat reported: 'We have learned that copper vessels lately sold in the circuits and prefectures fetch high prices because merchants are melting current coin for thick profit.'

sentences.zh: 乃下詔曰：「宜令遍行曉告，如元舊系銅器及碎銅，即許鑄造器物。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued: 'It is fitting to proclaim this everywhere. If it is originally registered copper vessels and scrap copper, casting vessels is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed: 'Proclaim everywhere that originally registered copper vessels and scrap copper may be cast into new vessels.

sentences.zh: 仍生銅器物每斤價定二百文，熟銅器物每斤四百文，如違省價，買賣之人依盜鑄錢律文科斷。」

translations.literal: Further, the price of raw-copper vessels is fixed at two hundred cash per jin, and wrought-copper vessels at four hundred cash per jin; if the reduced price is violated, buyers and sellers shall be sentenced under the statute on illicit coining.'
translations.idiomatic: Raw-copper vessels shall sell for no more than two hundred cash per jin and wrought-copper vessels for no more than four hundred cash per jin. Buyers and sellers who violate these price caps shall be sentenced under the statute on illicit coining.'

sentences.zh: 清泰二年十二月，詔御史臺曉告中外，禁用鉛錢，如違犯，準條流處分。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Qingtai, the Censorate was ordered to proclaim within and without the court that lead coin is forbidden; violators shall be dealt with according to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Qingtai 2 (935), the Censorate was ordered to proclaim throughout the realm that lead coin was forbidden; violators would be punished under the regulations.

sentences.zh: 晉天福二年，詔：「禁一切銅器，其銅鏡今後官鑄造，於東京置場貨賣，許人收買，於諸處興販去。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianfu of Jin, an edict stated: 'All copper vessels are forbidden. Copper mirrors shall hereafter be cast by the government; a market shall be set up in the Eastern Capital to sell them, and people are permitted to purchase them and carry them for trade elsewhere.'
translations.idiomatic: In Jin Tianfu 2 (937), an edict forbade all private copper vessels. Copper mirrors would henceforth be cast by the government and sold at a market in the Eastern Capital; purchasers might resell them elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 周廣順元年三月，敕：「銅法，今後官中更不禁斷，一任興販，所在一色即不得瀉破為銅器貨賣，如有犯者，有人糾告捉獲，所犯人不計多少斤兩，並處死。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, an edict stated: 'As for the copper law, hereafter the government will no longer forbid it and trade is fully permitted, but locally, ingots in standard form must not be melted and broken into copper vessels for sale. If there are violators and someone reports and they are seized, the offenders, regardless of how many jin, shall all be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Zhou Guangshun 1 (951), an edict declared: 'The copper trade will no longer be banned by the government, but standard ingots must not be melted into vessels for sale anywhere. Informers who report and capture offenders shall see the offenders put to death regardless of quantity.

sentences.zh: 其地分所由節級，決脊杖十七放，鄰保人決臀杖十七放，其告事人給與賞錢一百貫文。」

translations.literal: The local responsible officials and clerks shall receive seventeen strokes of the rod on the back and be released; guarantor neighbors shall receive seventeen strokes on the buttocks and be released; the informant shall be given a reward of one hundred strings of cash.'
translations.idiomatic: Local officials and clerks involved shall receive seventeen strokes on the back; guarantor neighbors shall receive seventeen strokes on the buttocks; informants shall receive a reward of one hundred strings of cash.'

sentences.zh: 江南因唐舊制，饒州置永平監，歲鑄錢，池州永寧監、建州永豐監，並歲鑄錢，杭州置保興監鑄錢。

translations.literal: Jiangnan, following the Tang old system, established the Yongping Mint at Raozhou, casting coin annually; the Yongning Mint at Chizhou and the Yongfeng Mint at Jianzhou also cast coin annually; Hangzhou established the Baoxing Mint to cast coin.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan followed the Tang system: Raozhou had the Yongping Mint casting coin yearly; Chizhou had the Yongning Mint and Jianzhou the Yongfeng Mint, both casting yearly; Hangzhou had the Baoxing Mint.

sentences.zh: 唐同光二年二月，詔曰：「會計之重，鹹鹺居先，矧彼兩池，實有豐利。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, an edict stated: 'In the weight of state accounting, salt comes first—how much more so those two pools, which truly yield abundant profit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongguang 2, an edict declared: 'In state finance, salt ranks first—and how much more the two pools, which yield rich profit.

sentences.zh: 頃自兵戈擾攘，民庶流離，既場務以隳殘，致程課之虧失。

translations.literal: Recently, since warfare has disturbed the realm and the people have been displaced, the salt offices have been ruined and the scheduled levies lost.
translations.idiomatic: Since warfare has ravaged the realm and displaced the people, the salt offices lie in ruins and scheduled revenues have been lost.

sentences.zh: 重茲葺理，須仗規模，將立事以成功，在從長而就便。

translations.literal: To restore this anew, a plan must be relied upon; to establish the undertaking and achieve success lies in following what is advantageous and adopting what is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Restoring them requires a clear plan: success depends on choosing the course that is both effective and practicable.

sentences.zh: 宜令河中節度使冀王李繼麟兼充制置度支安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽使，便可制，一一條貫。」

translations.literal: Prince Ji of Ji, Li Jilin, military commissioner of Hezhong, is appointed concurrently commissioner for planning revenue and monopoly salt commissioner of the Anyi and Jie county pools; he may at once draw up regulations, item by item.'
translations.idiomatic: Li Jilin, Prince Ji of Ji and military commissioner of Hezhong, is appointed concurrently to plan revenue and oversee the monopoly salt offices at the Anyi and Jie county pools; he shall draw up detailed regulations at once.'

sentences.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：同光三年二月，敕：「魏府每年所征隨絲鹽錢，每兩與減放五文；

translations.literal: (Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium: In the second month of the third year of Tongguang, an edict stated: 'The salt money levied with silk in Weifu each year shall be reduced by five cash per unit of two;
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium: In the second month of Tongguang 3, an edict ordered: 'The salt levy collected with silk in the Wei prefecture circuit shall be reduced by five cash per unit;

sentences.zh: 逐年亻表賣蠶鹽、食鹽、大鹽、甜次冷鹽，每鬥與減五十；

translations.literal: each year in distributed sale of silkworm salt, table salt, coarse salt, and sweet, secondary, and cold salt, fifty per dou shall be reduced;
translations.idiomatic: for the annual distribution of silkworm salt, table salt, coarse salt, and sweet, secondary, and cold salt, the price per dou shall be reduced by fifty;

sentences.zh: 欒鹽與減三十。」

translations.literal: for Luan salt, thirty shall be reduced.'
translations.idiomatic: for Luan salt, by thirty.'

sentences.zh: 天成元年四月，敕：「諸州府百姓合散蠶鹽，今後每年只二月內一度亻表散，依夏稅限納錢。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Tiancheng, an edict stated: 'The silkworm salt that the people of all prefectures should receive shall hereafter be distributed only once within the second month each year, with payment due by the deadline for the summer tax.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Tiancheng 1, an edict ordered: 'Silkworm salt distributed to the people of all prefectures shall hereafter be issued only once each year within the second month, with payment due by the summer-tax deadline.'

sentences.zh: 長興四年五月七日，諸道鹽錢轉運使奏：「諸道州府鹽法條流元末，一概定奪，謹具如後：應食顆鹽州府，省司各置榷糶折博場院。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Changxing, the salt-and-cash transport commissioner of the circuits memorialized: 'The salt-law regulations of the circuit prefectures originally had no unified conclusion; we have now decided them uniformly and respectfully present them as follows: In all prefectures that consume granular salt, each provincial office shall establish monopoly sale and barter yards.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the fifth month of Changxing 4 (933), the circuit salt-and-cash transport commissioner memorialized: 'Salt regulations across the circuits lacked a single standard; we have unified them as follows. In all prefectures that consume granular salt, each provincial office shall establish monopoly sale and barter yards.

sentences.zh: 應是鄉村，並通私商興販。

translations.literal: All villages may freely allow private merchants to trade.
translations.idiomatic: Villages may allow private merchants to trade freely.

sentences.zh: 所有折博並每年人戶蠶鹽，並不許將帶一斤一兩入城，侵奪榷糶課利。

translations.literal: All barter goods and the annual silkworm salt of households are not permitted to be brought into the city, even one jin or one liang, encroaching on monopoly-sale revenues.
translations.idiomatic: Barter goods and annual household silkworm salt may not be brought into cities even by the ounce, lest they undercut monopoly revenues.

sentences.zh: 如違犯者，一兩已上至一斤，買賣人各杖六十；

translations.literal: Violators from one liang up to one jin: buyers and sellers each receive sixty blows with the staff;
translations.idiomatic: Violators from one liang up to one jin: buyers and sellers each receive sixty blows with the staff;

sentences.zh: 一斤已上至三斤，買賣人各杖七十；

translations.literal: from one jin up to three jin: buyers and sellers each receive seventy blows;
translations.idiomatic: from one jin up to three jin: buyers and sellers each receive seventy blows;

sentences.zh: 三斤已上至五斤，買賣人各杖八十；

translations.literal: from three jin up to five jin: buyers and sellers each receive eighty blows;
translations.idiomatic: from three jin up to five jin: buyers and sellers each receive eighty blows;

sentences.zh: 五斤已上至十斤，買賣人各徒二年；

translations.literal: from five jin up to ten jin: buyers and sellers each are sentenced to two years' penal servitude;
translations.idiomatic: from five jin up to ten jin: buyers and sellers each receive two years' penal servitude;

sentences.zh: 十斤已上，不計多少，買賣人各決脊杖二十，處死。

translations.literal: ten jin and above, regardless of amount: buyers and sellers each receive twenty blows on the back and are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: ten jin and above, regardless of amount: buyers and sellers each receive twenty blows on the back and are put to death.

sentences.zh: 所有犯鹽人隨行錢物、驢畜等，並納入官。

translations.literal: All cash, goods, donkeys, and livestock accompanying salt offenders shall be confiscated to the government.
translations.idiomatic: All cash, goods, donkeys, and livestock accompanying offenders shall be confiscated.

sentences.zh: 所有元本家業莊田，如是全家逃走者，即行點納。

translations.literal: The original family estates and fields: if the whole family has fled, they shall be inventoried and seized.
translations.idiomatic: If an offender's entire family has fled, their original estates and fields shall be inventoried and seized.

sentences.zh: 仍許般載腳戶、經過店主並腳下人力等糾告，等第支與優給。

translations.literal: Carriers, innkeepers along the route, and porters are permitted to report violations and shall receive graded generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Carriers, innkeepers along the route, and porters may report violations and shall receive graded generous rewards.

sentences.zh: 如知情不告，與賣鹽人同罪。

translations.literal: Those who know but do not report share the same crime as the salt sellers.
translations.idiomatic: Those who know but fail to report share the sellers' punishment.

sentences.zh: 其犯鹽人經過處，地分門司、廂界巡檢、節級所由並諸色關連人等，不專覺察，委本州臨時斷訖報省。

translations.literal: At places offenders pass through, local gate clerks, ward patrol inspectors, clerks, and all related persons who do not devote themselves to detection shall be left to the prefecture for summary judgment and report to the province.
translations.idiomatic: Local gate clerks, ward patrol inspectors, clerks, and all others along an offender's route who fail to detect violations shall be judged summarily by the prefecture and reported to the provincial office.

sentences.zh: 如是門司關津口鋪，捉獲私鹽，即依下項等第，支給一半賞錢：十斤以上至五十斤，支賞錢二十千；

translations.literal: If gate clerks at passes and checkpoints seize private salt, rewards shall be paid at half value according to the grades below: from ten jin up to fifty jin, twenty thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: Gate clerks at passes and checkpoints who seize private salt shall receive half-value rewards by grade: ten to fifty jin, twenty thousand cash;

sentences.zh: 五十斤已上至一百斤，支賞錢三十千；

translations.literal: from fifty jin up to one hundred jin, thirty thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: fifty to one hundred jin, thirty thousand cash;

sentences.zh: 一百斤已上，支賞錢五十千。

translations.literal: one hundred jin and above, fifty thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: one hundred jin and above, fifty thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 應食末鹽地界，州府縣鎮並有榷糶場院久來內外禁法，即未一概條流。

translations.literal: In territories that consume fine salt, prefectures, counties, and market towns all have monopoly yards with long-standing internal and external prohibitions; these have not yet been unified in regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In territories that consume fine salt, prefectures, counties, and market towns have long had monopoly yards with internal and external prohibitions; these have not yet been unified.

sentences.zh: 應刮鹹煎鹽，不計多少斤兩，並處極法，兼許四鄰及諸色人等陳告，等第支給賞錢。

translations.literal: For scraping brine and boiling salt, regardless of jin or liang, all shall receive the extreme penalty; neighbors and all others are permitted to report, with graded reward money.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who scrapes brine to boil salt, regardless of quantity, shall receive the death penalty; neighbors and others may report violations for graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 欲指揮此後犯一兩已上至一斤，買賣人各杖六十；

translations.literal: It is proposed to order that hereafter, from one liang up to one jin, buyers and sellers each receive sixty blows;
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, from one liang up to one jin, buyers and sellers each receive sixty blows;

sentences.zh: 一斤已上至二斤，買賣人各杖七十；

translations.literal: from one jin up to two jin, seventy blows each;
translations.idiomatic: from one jin up to two jin, seventy blows each;

sentences.zh: 二斤以上至三斤，買賣人各徒一年；

translations.literal: from two jin up to three jin, one year of penal servitude each;
translations.idiomatic: from two jin up to three jin, one year of penal servitude each;

sentences.zh: 三斤以上至五斤，買賣人各徒二年；

translations.literal: from three jin up to five jin, two years each;
translations.idiomatic: from three jin up to five jin, two years each;

sentences.zh: 五斤已上，買賣人各決脊杖二十，處死。

translations.literal: five jin and above, twenty blows on the back and death.
translations.idiomatic: five jin and above, twenty blows on the back and death.

sentences.zh: 如是收到鹹土鹽水，即委本處煎煉鹽數，準條科斷。

translations.literal: If briny earth or salt water is seized, the local office shall boil the salt and sentence according to the statute by quantity.
translations.idiomatic: If briny earth or salt water is seized, the local office shall boil out the salt and sentence by quantity under the statute.

sentences.zh: 或有已曾違犯，不至死刑，經斷後公然不懼條流再犯者，不計斤兩多少，所犯人並處極法。

translations.literal: If someone has previously violated the law short of death, and after judgment openly fears no regulations and violates again, regardless of jin or liang, the offender shall receive the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone previously convicted of a non-capital salt offense who openly violates the law again shall receive the death penalty regardless of quantity.

sentences.zh: 其有榷糶場院員僚節級人力、煎鹽池客竈戶、般鹽船綱、押綱軍將衙官梢工等，具知鹽法，如有公然偷盜官鹽，或將貨賣，其買賣人及窩盤主人知情不告，並依前項刮鹹例，五斤已上處死。

translations.literal: Monopoly-yard clerks, salt-pool guests, kiln households, salt-transport convoy leaders, escort officers, and boat hands who fully know the salt laws—if they openly steal government salt or sell it, buyers and den keepers who know but do not report shall all follow the preceding rule on scraping brine: five jin and above, death.
translations.idiomatic: Monopoly-yard clerks, salt-pool workers, kiln households, transport convoy leaders, escort officers, and boat hands who know the salt laws but steal government salt or sell it, together with buyers and den keepers who know but fail to report, shall be sentenced like brine-scrapers: death for five jin or more.

sentences.zh: 其諸色關連人等，並合支賞錢，即準洛京邢鎮條流事例指揮。

translations.literal: All related persons shall receive reward money according to the regulations and precedents of Luoyang and Xing town.
translations.idiomatic: All related persons shall receive rewards according to the regulations and precedents of Luoyang and Xing town.

sentences.zh: 顆、末、青、白等鹽，元不許界分參雜。

translations.literal: Granular, fine, green, and white salts were originally not permitted to be mixed across boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Granular, fine, green, and white salts were not originally permitted to cross boundaries or be mixed.

sentences.zh: 其顆鹽先許通商之時指揮，不得將帶入末鹽地界。

translations.literal: When granular salt was first permitted for general trade, orders forbade bringing it into fine-salt territories.
translations.idiomatic: When granular salt was first permitted for general trade, orders forbade bringing it into fine-salt territories.

sentences.zh: 如有違犯，一斤一兩，並處極法，所有隨行物色，除鹽外，一半納官，一半與捉事人充賞。

translations.literal: Violators, even one jin or one liang, all receive the extreme penalty; of goods carried, except salt, half goes to the government and half to the captors as reward.
translations.idiomatic: Violators, even by the ounce, receive the death penalty; of goods carried, except salt, half goes to the government and half to the captors.

sentences.zh: 其餘鹽色，未有畫一條流。

translations.literal: For the remaining salt types, there are no unified regulations.
translations.idiomatic: For other salt types, no unified regulations yet exist.

sentences.zh: 其洛京並鎮、定、邢州管內，多北京末鹽入界，捉獲並依洛京條流科斷。

translations.literal: Within Luoyang and the jurisdictions of Zhen, Ding, and Xing prefectures, much northern fine salt enters the border; seizures are sentenced according to Luoyang regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Within Luoyang and the jurisdictions of Zhen, Ding, and Xing, much northern fine salt crosses the border; seizures are sentenced under Luoyang regulations.

sentences.zh: 欲指揮此後但是顆、末、青、白諸色鹽侵界參雜，捉獲並準洛京條流施行。」

translations.literal: It is proposed to order that hereafter whenever granular, fine, green, or white salt crosses boundaries or is mixed, seizures shall follow Luoyang regulations.'
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, whenever granular, fine, green, or white salt crosses boundaries or is mixed, seizures shall follow Luoyang regulations.'

sentences.zh: 「一應諸道，今後若捉獲犯私鹽曲人，罪犯分明，正該條法，便仰斷遣訖奏。

translations.literal: 'First, in all circuits, if private-salt offenders are seized and the crime is clear and properly covered by statute, they shall be sentenced and dispatched at once and then reported.
translations.idiomatic: 'First, in all circuits, when private-salt offenders are seized and the crime is clear and covered by statute, sentence and dispatch them at once, then report.

sentences.zh: 若稍涉疑誤，只須申奏取裁。」）〉

translations.literal: If there is the slightest doubt or error, a memorial need only be submitted for imperial decision.' )〉
translations.idiomatic: If there is any doubt, submit a memorial for imperial decision.' )〉

sentences.zh: 晉天福中，河南、河北諸州，除俵散蠶鹽征錢外，每年末鹽界分場務，約糶錢一十七萬貫有餘。

translations.literal: In the Tianfu period of Jin, in the prefectures of Henan and Hebei, apart from the money levied for distributed silkworm salt, the fine-salt monopoly yards in the border zones annually brought in a little more than 170,000 strings from monopoly sales.
translations.idiomatic: During Jin Tianfu, Henan and Hebei prefectures, apart from levies on distributed silkworm salt, collected a little over 170,000 strings annually from fine-salt monopoly yards in the border zones.

sentences.zh: 言事者稱，雖得此錢，百姓多犯鹽法，請將上件食鹽錢於諸道州府計戶，每戶一貫至二百，為五等配之，然後任人逐便興販，既不虧官，又益百姓。

translations.literal: Memorialists said that although this money was obtained, the people frequently violated the salt laws. They requested that the aforesaid table-salt money be assessed by household across the circuits, from one string down to two hundred cash in five grades, and then people be allowed to trade freely as they wished—neither harming the state nor failing to benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists argued that although the state collected this revenue, the people frequently violated salt laws. They proposed assessing the table-salt levy by household across the circuits in five grades from one string down to two hundred cash, then allowing free trade—benefiting both state and people.

sentences.zh: 朝廷行之，諸處場務亦且仍舊。

translations.literal: The court carried this out, but the local yards for the time being remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: The court adopted the plan, but local monopoly yards remained in place for the time being.

sentences.zh: 俄而鹽貨頓賤，去出鹽遠處州縣，每斤不過二十文，近處不過一十文，掌事者又難驟改其法，奏請重制鹽場稅，蓋欲絕其興販，歸利於官也。

translations.literal: Soon salt goods abruptly fell in price; in distant prefectures and counties far from salt sources, each jin was no more than twenty cash, and nearby no more than ten. Those in charge found it hard to change the law abruptly and memorialized to reimpose salt-yard taxes, intending to cut off free trade and return profit to the government.
translations.idiomatic: Soon salt prices collapsed: in distant counties far from production, a jin sold for no more than twenty cash, and nearby for no more than ten. Officials, unable to reverse course quickly, memorialized to reimpose salt-yard taxes to choke off free trade and restore revenue to the state.

sentences.zh: 周廣順元年九月，詔改鹽法，凡犯五斤已上者處死，煎鹼鹽犯一斤已上者處死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, an edict revised the salt law: all who violate five jin or more are put to death; those who boil alkaline salt in violation, one jin or more, are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Zhou Guangshun 1, an edict revised the salt law: violations of five jin or more carry the death penalty; boiling alkaline salt in violation, one jin or more, carries the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 先是漢法不計斤兩多少，並處極刑，至是始革之。

translations.literal: Previously under Han law, regardless of jin or liang, all received the extreme penalty; only now was this first reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the previous Han law, any quantity had carried the death penalty; only now was that first reformed.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，詔曰：「青白池務，素有定規，只自近年，頗乖循守。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year, an edict stated: 'The green-and-white pool offices have long had fixed regulations, but only in recent years has observance greatly diverged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year, an edict declared: 'The green-and-white salt pool offices have long had fixed regulations, but in recent years observance has greatly diverged.

sentences.zh: 比來青鹽一石，抽稅錢八百文足陌、鹽一斗；

translations.literal: Recently for green salt, one shi was taxed eight hundred cash in full strings and one dou of salt;
translations.idiomatic: Recently green salt was taxed at eight hundred full-string cash and one dou of salt per shi;

sentences.zh: 白鹽一石，抽稅錢五百文、鹽五升。

translations.literal: for white salt, one shi was taxed five hundred cash and five sheng of salt.
translations.idiomatic: white salt at five hundred cash and five sheng of salt per shi.

sentences.zh: 其後青鹽一石，抽錢一千、鹽一斗。

translations.literal: Afterward for green salt, one shi was taxed one thousand cash and one dou of salt.
translations.idiomatic: Later green salt was taxed at one thousand cash and one dou of salt per shi.

sentences.zh: 訪聞更改已來，不便商販，蕃人漢戶，求利艱難，宜與優饒，庶令存濟。

translations.literal: It has been learned through inquiry that since the changes were made, trade has been inconvenient; Tibetan and Han households find it hard to seek profit; they should be given favorable treatment so that they may survive.
translations.idiomatic: Reports indicate that since the reforms trade has grown difficult; both frontier peoples and Han households struggle to turn a profit. They should receive favorable treatment so they can get by.

sentences.zh: 今後每青鹽一石，依舊抽稅錢八百文，以八十五為陌，鹽一斗；

translations.literal: From now on for each shi of green salt, as before a tax of eight hundred cash shall be levied, counting eighty-five to the string, and one dou of salt;
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth each shi of green salt shall be taxed as before at eight hundred cash per string of eighty-five, plus one dou of salt;

sentences.zh: 白鹽一石，抽稅錢五百，鹽五升。

translations.literal: for white salt one shi, a tax of five hundred cash and five sheng of salt.
translations.idiomatic: white salt at five hundred cash and five sheng of salt per shi.

sentences.zh: 此外更不得別有邀求。

translations.literal: Beyond this there must be no further demands whatsoever.
translations.idiomatic: No additional exactions may be imposed beyond this.

sentences.zh: 訪聞邊上鎮鋪，於蕃漢戶市易糶糴，衷私有抽稅，今後一切止絕。」

translations.literal: It has been learned through inquiry that frontier garrison shops, in buying and selling grain with Tibetan and Han households, privately impose taxes in violation; from now on all such practices shall cease entirely.'
translations.idiomatic: Reports also indicate that frontier garrison shops have been levying unauthorized taxes on grain trade with Tibetan and Han households; such practices are hereby prohibited entirely.'

sentences.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：周廣順二年九月十八日，敕：「條流禁私鹽曲法如後：一、諸色犯鹽曲，所犯一斤已下至一兩，杖八十，配役；

translations.literal: (Records of the Five Dynasties: On the eighteenth day of the ninth month of the second year of Guangshun of Zhou, an edict: 'The articles prohibiting private salt and yeast are as follows: 1. For all violations of salt and yeast, from one jin down to one liang, eighty blows with the staff and corvée assignment;
translations.idiomatic: (Five Dynasties Essentials: On the eighteenth day of the ninth month of Zhou Guangshun 2, an edict: 'Articles prohibiting private salt and yeast are as follows: 1. For salt and yeast violations from one jin down to one liang: eighty blows with the staff and corvée assignment;

sentences.zh: 五斤以下一斤以上，徒三年，配役；

translations.literal: from five jin down to one jin or more, three years of penal servitude and corvée assignment;
translations.idiomatic: from five jin down to one jin or more: three years of penal servitude and corvée assignment;

sentences.zh: 五斤以上，並決重杖一頓，處死。

translations.literal: five jin or more, all receive one heavy beating and are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: five jin or more: one heavy beating and execution.

sentences.zh: 一、應所犯鹽曲，關津門司、廂巡門保，如有透漏，並行勘斷。

translations.literal: 1. For salt and yeast violations, customs gate officers, patrol guards, and ward mutual-supervision groups who allow leakage shall all be investigated and punished.
translations.idiomatic: 1. For salt and yeast violations, customs gate officers, patrol guards, and ward mutual-supervision groups who allow smuggling through shall all be investigated and punished.

sentences.zh: 一、刮鹼煎煉私鹽，所犯一斤已下，徒三年，配役；

translations.literal: 1. For scraping alkali and boiling private salt, violations of one jin or less, three years of penal servitude and corvée assignment;
translations.idiomatic: 1. For scraping alkali to boil private salt, one jin or less: three years of penal servitude and corvée assignment;

sentences.zh: 一斤以上，並決重杖一頓，處死。

translations.literal: one jin or more, all receive one heavy beating and are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: one jin or more: one heavy beating and execution.

sentences.zh: 犯私鹽若捉到堿水，只煎成鹽，秤盤定罪，逐處凡有鹼鹵之地，所在官吏節級所由，常須巡檢，村坊鄰保，遞相覺察，若有所犯處彰露，並行勘斷。

translations.literal: In private-salt cases, if alkaline brine is seized and only boiled into salt, sentence according to the weight on the scale. Wherever alkali brine lands exist, local officials and officers at every level must regularly patrol; village wards and mutual-supervision neighbors must watch one another, and if violations are exposed, all shall be investigated and punished.
translations.idiomatic: In private-salt cases, if alkaline brine is seized and boiled into salt, sentence according to the finished salt weighed on the scale. Wherever alkali brine lands exist, local officials and officers at every level must patrol regularly; village wards and mutual-supervision neighbors must watch one another, and any exposed violation shall be investigated and punished.

sentences.zh: 一、所犯私鹽，捉事、告事人各支賞錢，以系省錢充。

translations.literal: 1. For private-salt violations, informants and accusers each receive reward money, paid from provincial funds.
translations.idiomatic: 1. For private-salt violations, informants and accusers each receive reward money from provincial funds.

sentences.zh: 至死刑者賞錢五十千，不及死刑者三十千。

translations.literal: For cases reaching the death penalty, reward money of fifty strings; for those not reaching the death penalty, thirty strings.
translations.idiomatic: Cases warranting execution: fifty strings; cases not warranting execution: thirty strings.

sentences.zh: 一、顆末鹽各有界分，若將本地分鹽侵越疆界，同諸色犯鹽例科斷。

translations.literal: 1. Crystal salt and fine salt each have territorial boundaries; if salt from one's own zone encroaches across the border, it is punished under the same rules as all other salt violations.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Crystal salt and fine salt each have territorial boundaries; salt from one zone that encroaches across a border is punished under the same rules as other salt violations.

sentences.zh: 一、鄉村人戶，所請蠶鹽，只得將歸零躉供食，不得別將博易貨賣，投托與人。

translations.literal: 1. Rural households who receive allocated silkworm salt may only take it home for consumption in small lots; they may not trade it, sell goods with it, or entrust it to others.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Rural households who receive allocated silkworm salt may only use it at home for food and small bulk purchases; they may not trade, sell, or entrust it to others.

sentences.zh: 如違，並同諸色犯鹽例科斷。

translations.literal: If violated, all are punished under the same rules as all other salt violations.
translations.idiomatic: Violations are punished under the same rules as other salt offenses.

sentences.zh: 若是所請蠶鹽，道路津濟須經過州府縣鎮，委三司明行指揮。

translations.literal: If allocated silkworm salt must pass through state, prefecture, county, or market-town checkpoints on the road, the Three Departments shall issue clear directives.
translations.idiomatic: If allocated silkworm salt must pass through prefecture, county, or market-town checkpoints on the road, the Three Departments shall issue clear directives.

sentences.zh: 一、凡買鹽曲，並須於官場務內買，若衷私投托興販，其買賣人並同諸色犯鹽曲例科斷。

translations.literal: 1. All purchases of salt and yeast must be made at official monopoly offices; if there is private dealing or unauthorized trading, both buyer and seller are punished under the same rules as all other salt and yeast violations.
translations.idiomatic: 1. All salt and yeast must be purchased at official monopoly offices; private dealing or unauthorized trading subjects both buyer and seller to the same penalties as other salt and yeast violations.

sentences.zh: 一、諸官場官務，如有羨余出剩鹽曲，並許盡底報官。

translations.literal: 1. At all official monopoly offices, if there is surplus salt or yeast, it may all be fully reported to the government.
translations.idiomatic: 1. At all official monopoly offices, any surplus salt or yeast must be fully reported to the government.

sentences.zh: 如衷私貨賣者，買賣人並同諸色犯鹽曲例科斷。

translations.literal: If sold privately in violation, buyer and seller are both punished under the same rules as all other salt and yeast violations.
translations.idiomatic: Private sale subjects both buyer and seller to the same penalties as other salt and yeast violations.

sentences.zh: 若鹽鋪酒店戶及諸色人與場院衷私貨賣者，並同罪科斷。

translations.literal: If salt shops, wine shops, or persons of any category privately deal with monopoly yards in unauthorized sales, all are punished as co-offenders.
translations.idiomatic: Salt shops, wine shops, or any others who privately deal with monopoly yards in unauthorized sales are equally liable.

sentences.zh: 一、所犯私鹽曲，有同情共犯者，若是骨肉卑幼奴婢同犯，只罪家長主首。

translations.literal: 1. In private salt and yeast violations where there are co-conspirators sharing intent, if relatives of lower status, children, or slaves commit the offense together, only the household head is punished.
translations.idiomatic: 1. When co-conspirators share intent in private salt or yeast violations, if relatives of lower status, children, or slaves commit the offense together, only the household head is punished.

sentences.zh: 如家長主首不知情，只罪造意者，余減等科斷。

translations.literal: If the household head was unaware, only the instigator is punished; the rest receive reduced sentences.
translations.idiomatic: If the household head was unaware, only the instigator is punished; the others receive reduced sentences.

sentences.zh: 若是他人同犯，並同罪斷。

translations.literal: If others commit the offense together, all are punished equally.
translations.idiomatic: If others commit the offense together, all are punished equally.

sentences.zh: 若與他人同犯，據逐人腳下所犯斤兩，依輕重斷遣。

translations.literal: If committing the offense with others, according to the jin and liang each person personally handled, sentence according to severity.
translations.idiomatic: If committing the offense with others, each person is sentenced according to the weight of salt he personally handled.

sentences.zh: 一、州城縣鎮郭下人戶，系屋稅合請鹽者，若是州府，並於城內請給，若是外縣鎮郭下人戶，亦許將鹽歸家供食。

translations.literal: 1. Urban households in prefecture cities, counties, and market towns who are liable for house-tax salt: if in a prefectural city, all receive allocation within the city; if suburban county or market-town households, they may also take salt home for consumption.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Urban households in prefecture cities, counties, and market towns liable for house-tax salt: prefectural households receive allocation within the city; suburban county and market-town households may also take salt home for consumption.

sentences.zh: 仰本縣預取逐戶合請鹽數目，攢定文賬，部領人戶請拔，勒本處官吏及所在場務，同點檢入城。

translations.literal: Each county is ordered to collect in advance each household's salt quota, compile written accounts, lead households to collect it, and require local officials and the monopoly offices concerned to inspect together upon entry to the city.
translations.idiomatic: Each county shall collect in advance each household's salt quota, compile written accounts, lead households to collect it, and require local officials and monopoly offices to inspect together upon entry to the city.

sentences.zh: 若縣鎮郭下人戶，城外別有莊田，亦仰本縣預先分擘開坐，勿令一處分給供使。」

translations.literal: If suburban county or market-town households have farmsteads outside the wall, the county is also ordered to divide and register them in advance, and not allow distribution from a single location for all uses.'
translations.idiomatic: If suburban households have farmsteads outside the wall, the county shall divide and register them in advance so that salt is not distributed from a single location for all uses.'

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，敕：「諸州府並外縣鎮城內，其居人屋稅鹽，今後不亻表，其鹽錢亦不征納。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year, an edict: 'In all prefectures and outer counties and market towns within the walls, house-tax salt for residents shall no longer be distributed; the salt money shall also not be collected.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year, an edict: 'In all prefectures and outer counties and market towns within the walls, house-tax salt for residents shall no longer be distributed; the salt levy shall also not be collected.

sentences.zh: 所有鄉村人戶合請蠶鹽，所在州城縣鎮嚴切檢校，不得放入城門。」）〉

translations.literal: All rural households entitled to silkworm salt shall be strictly inspected by the prefectures, cities, counties, and market towns concerned and may not be allowed through the city gates.' )〉
translations.idiomatic: All rural households entitled to silkworm salt shall be strictly inspected by local prefectures, cities, counties, and market towns and may not be allowed through the city gates.' )〉

sentences.zh: 顯德元年十二月，世宗謂侍臣曰：「朕覽食末鹽州郡，犯私鹽多於顆鹽界分，蓋卑濕之地，易為刮鹼煎造，豈惟違我榷法，兼又汙我好鹽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Xiande, Emperor Shizong said to his attendants: 'I have reviewed the prefectures consuming fine salt and find that private-salt violations exceed those in crystal-salt zones, because low-lying damp lands make it easy to scrape alkali and boil salt. This not only violates our monopoly law but also taints our good salt.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Xiande 1, Emperor Shizong told his attendants: 'I have reviewed the fine-salt prefectures and find private-salt violations exceed those in crystal-salt zones, because low-lying damp lands make it easy to scrape alkali and boil salt. This not only violates our monopoly law but also taints our good salt.

sentences.zh: 況末鹽煎煉，般運費用倍於顆鹽。

translations.literal: Moreover, boiling fine salt costs twice as much to transport as crystal salt.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, boiling and transporting fine salt costs twice as much as crystal salt.

sentences.zh: 今宜分割十餘州，令食顆鹽，不惟輦運省力，兼且少人犯禁。」

translations.literal: Now more than ten prefectures should be divided off and made to consume crystal salt; this would not only save cart transport labor but also reduce violations.'
translations.idiomatic: More than ten prefectures should now be set apart to consume crystal salt—this would save transport labor and reduce violations.

sentences.zh: 自是曹、宋已西十餘州，皆盡食顆鹽。

translations.literal: From this time Cao, Song, and more than ten prefectures to the west all consumed crystal salt entirely.
translations.idiomatic: From this time Cao, Song, and more than ten prefectures to the west all switched entirely to crystal salt.

sentences.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：顯德二年八月二十四日，宣頭節文：「改立鹽法如後：一、贍國軍堂場務、邢洺州鹽務，應有見垛貯鹽貨處，並煎鹽場竈及應是鹼地，並須四面修置墻塹。

translations.literal: (Records of the Five Dynasties: On the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month of the second year of Xiande, a memorial edict: 'The revised salt law is as follows: 1. At the Zhan'guo Army hall offices and the Xing and Mo prefecture salt offices, wherever stored salt exists, salt-boiling fields and furnaces, and all alkali lands, walls and ditches must be built on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: (Five Dynasties Essentials: On the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month of Xiande 2, a memorial edict: 'The revised salt law is as follows: 1. At the Zhan'guo Army hall offices and the Xing and Mo prefecture salt offices, wherever stored salt, salt-boiling fields and furnaces, and alkali lands exist, walls and ditches must be built on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 如是地裏遙遠，難為修置墻塹，即作壕籬為規隔。

translations.literal: If the land is remote and walls and ditches are hard to build, trenches and fences shall serve as barriers.
translations.idiomatic: If the land is too remote for walls and ditches, trenches and fences shall serve as barriers.

sentences.zh: 如是人於壕籬內偷盜，夾帶官鹽，兼於壕籬外煎造鹽貨，便仰收捉，及許諸色人陳告。

translations.literal: If anyone steals within the trench-fence, carrying official salt concealed, or boils salt goods outside the trench-fence, they shall be arrested, and persons of all categories may denounce them.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who steals within the trench-fence while concealing official salt, or boils salt outside it, shall be arrested, and denunciation by persons of any category is permitted.

sentences.zh: 所犯不計多少斤兩，並決重杖一頓，處死。

translations.literal: Regardless of how many jin or liang are involved, all receive one heavy beating and are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Regardless of weight, all receive one heavy beating and execution.

sentences.zh: 其經歷地分及門司節級人員，並當量罪勘斷。

translations.literal: Local officials through whose jurisdiction they passed and gate officers at every level shall all be punished in proportion to their offense.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials through whose jurisdiction they passed and gate officers at every level shall all be punished in proportion to their offense.

sentences.zh: 所有捉事、告事人賞錢，一兩以上至一斤，賞錢二十千；

translations.literal: Reward money for informants and accusers: from one liang up to one jin, reward money of twenty strings;
translations.idiomatic: Reward money for informants and accusers: from one liang up to one jin, twenty strings;

sentences.zh: 一斤已上至十斤，賞錢三十千；

translations.literal: from one jin up to ten jin, reward money of thirty strings;
translations.idiomatic: from one jin up to ten jin, thirty strings;

sentences.zh: 一十斤已上，賞錢五十千。

translations.literal: ten jin or more, reward money of fifty strings.
translations.idiomatic: ten jin or more, fifty strings.

sentences.zh: 一、應有不系官中煎鹽處鹼地，並須標識，委本州府差公幹職員與巡檢節級、村保、地主、鄰人，同共巡檢。

translations.literal: 1. All alkali lands not under official salt production must be marked; the prefecture shall dispatch duty officers together with patrol officers, village mutual-supervision groups, landowners, and neighbors to patrol jointly.
translations.idiomatic: 1. All alkali lands not under official salt production must be marked; the prefecture shall dispatch duty officers together with patrol officers, village mutual-supervision groups, landowners, and neighbors to patrol jointly.

sentences.zh: 若諸色人偷刮鹵地，便仰收捉，及許人陳告。

translations.literal: If persons of any category secretly scrape brine lands, they shall be arrested, and denunciation is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If persons of any category secretly scrape brine lands, they shall be arrested, and denunciation is permitted.

sentences.zh: 若勘逐不虛，捉事人每獲一人，賞絹一十匹；

translations.literal: If investigation proves true, for each person seized the arresting party receives ten bolts of silk;
translations.idiomatic: If investigation proves true, for each person seized the arresting party receives ten bolts of silk;

sentences.zh: 獲二人，賞絹二十匹；

translations.literal: for two persons seized, twenty bolts of silk;
translations.idiomatic: for two persons seized, twenty bolts of silk;

sentences.zh: 獲三人已上，不計人數，賞絹五十匹。

translations.literal: for three persons or more seized, regardless of number, fifty bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: for three or more persons seized, regardless of number, fifty bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 刮鹼煎鹽人並知情人，所犯不計多少斤兩，並決重杖一頓，處死。

translations.literal: Those who scrape alkali to boil salt and those who knew of it, regardless of how many jin or liang are involved, all receive one heavy beating and are put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Those who scrape alkali to boil salt and those who knew of it, regardless of weight, all receive one heavy beating and execution.

sentences.zh: 其刮鹼處地分，並刮鹼人住處巡檢、節級、所由、村保等，各徒二年半，令眾一月，依舊勾當。

translations.literal: Patrol officers, local officers, agents, and village mutual-supervision groups at the scraping site and at the scraper's residence each receive two and a half years of penal servitude, public humiliation for one month, and then return to duty as before.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol officers, local officers, agents, and village mutual-supervision groups at the scraping site and at the scraper's residence each receive two and a half years of penal servitude, one month of public humiliation, and then return to duty.

sentences.zh: 刮堿處地主，不切檢校，徒二年，令眾一月。

translations.literal: Landowners at the scraping site who failed to inspect diligently receive two years of penal servitude and public humiliation for one month.
translations.idiomatic: Landowners at the scraping site who failed to inspect diligently receive two years of penal servitude and one month of public humiliation.

sentences.zh: 一、顆鹽地分界內，有人刮鹼煎煉鹽貨，所犯並依前法。

translations.literal: 1. Within crystal-salt territorial boundaries, anyone who scrapes alkali and boils salt goods is punished under the preceding law.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Within crystal-salt territorial boundaries, anyone who scrapes alkali to boil salt is punished under the preceding law.

sentences.zh: 一、今緣改價賣鹽，慮有別界分鹽貨遞相侵犯，及將鹽入城，諸色犯鹽人，令下三司，依下項條流科斷；

translations.literal: 1. Because salt prices are being changed, lest salt goods from other zones encroach upon one another and salt be brought into cities, all salt violators are ordered sent down to the Three Departments to be sentenced under the following articles;
translations.idiomatic: 1. Because salt prices are being changed, lest salt from other zones encroach and salt be brought into cities, all salt violators shall be sentenced by the Three Departments under the following articles;

sentences.zh: 其犯鹽人隨行物色，給與本家，其鹽沒納入官。

translations.literal: the violator's traveling goods are given to his household; the salt is confiscated to the state.
translations.idiomatic: the violator's traveling goods go to his household; the salt is confiscated to the state.

sentences.zh: 所經歷地分節級人員，並行勘斷。

translations.literal: Local officials at every level through whose jurisdiction they passed shall all be investigated and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials at every level through whose jurisdiction they passed shall all be investigated and punished.

sentences.zh: 一兩至一斤，決臀杖十五，令眾半月，捉事、告事人賞錢五千；

translations.literal: from one liang to one jin, fifteen buttock strokes, public humiliation for half a month, reward money of five thousand cash for informants and accusers;
translations.idiomatic: from one liang to one jin: fifteen buttock strokes, half a month of public humiliation, five thousand cash reward for informants and accusers;

sentences.zh: 一斤已上至一十斤，徒一年半，令眾一月，捉事、告事人賞錢七千；

translations.literal: from one jin up to ten jin, one and a half years of penal servitude, public humiliation for one month, reward money of seven thousand cash for informants and accusers;
translations.idiomatic: from one jin up to ten jin: one and a half years of penal servitude, one month of public humiliation, seven thousand cash reward for informants and accusers;

sentences.zh: 十斤已上，不計多少，徒二年，配發運務役一年，捉事、告事人賞錢十千。

translations.literal: ten jin or more, regardless of amount, two years of penal servitude, one year of corvée at transport offices, reward money of ten thousand cash for informants and accusers.
translations.idiomatic: ten jin or more, regardless of amount: two years of penal servitude, one year of corvée at transport offices, ten thousand cash reward for informants and accusers.

sentences.zh: 一、諸州府人戶所請蠶鹽，不得於鄉村衷私貨賣，及信團頭、腳戶、縣司、請鹽節級、所由等克折糶賣，如有犯者，依諸色犯鹽例科斷。

translations.literal: 1. Silkworm salt allocated to prefectural households may not be privately sold in villages, nor may group leaders, porters, county clerks, salt-allocation officers, and local agents skim and resell grain; if there are violators, they are punished under the rules for all salt violations.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Silkworm salt allocated to prefectural households may not be privately sold in villages, nor may group leaders, porters, county clerks, salt-allocation officers, or local agents skim and resell it; violators are punished under general salt rules.

sentences.zh: 一、如有人於河東界將鹽過來，及自家界內有人往彼興販鹽貨，所犯者並處斬。

translations.literal: 1. If anyone brings salt across from the Hedong border, or anyone within this zone goes there to trade in salt goods, all violators are executed.
translations.idiomatic: 1. Anyone who brings salt across from the Hedong border, or sells salt from this zone into that border, shall be executed.

sentences.zh: 其犯鹽人隨行驢畜資財，並與捉事人充賞。」

translations.literal: The violator's traveling donkeys, livestock, and property all go to the arresting party as reward.'
translations.idiomatic: The violator's donkeys, livestock, and property go to the arresting party as reward.'

sentences.zh: 「慶州青白榷稅院，元有透稅條流，所有隨行驢畜物色，一半支與捉事人充賞，其餘一半並鹽，並納入官。

translations.literal: 'The green-and-white monopoly tax office at Qing Prefecture originally had articles on tax evasion: half of the traveling donkeys, livestock, and goods go to the arresting party as reward; the remaining half together with the salt are all turned in to the state.
translations.idiomatic: 'The green-and-white monopoly tax office at Qing Prefecture originally had smuggling articles: half of the traveling donkeys, livestock, and goods go to the arresting party as reward; the rest, together with the salt, goes to the state.

sentences.zh: 欲並且依舊一斗已上至三斗杖七十，三斗已上至五斗徒一年，五斗已上處死。

translations.literal: It is desired to retain as before: from one dou up to three dou, seventy staff blows; from three dou up to five dou, one year of penal servitude; five dou or more, put to death.
translations.idiomatic: It is desired to retain as before: from one dou up to three dou, seventy staff blows; from three dou up to five dou, one year of penal servitude; five dou or more, execution.

sentences.zh: 安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽院，河府節度使兼判之時申到畫一事件條流等，準敕牒，兩池所出鹽，舊日苦無文榜，如擅將一斤一兩，準元敕條，並處極法。

translations.literal: The two pool monopoly salt offices at Anyi and Jie counties—when the Hedong circuit governor concurrently judged, unified articles on cases were submitted; according to the edict, salt from the two pools formerly had no posted regulations, and unauthorized removal of even one jin or one liang is punished under the original edict articles with the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: The two pool monopoly salt offices at Anyi and Jie counties—when the Hedong governor concurrently judged, unified case articles were submitted; per edict, salt from the two pools formerly had no posted regulations, and unauthorized removal of even one jin or one liang carries the maximum penalty under the original edict articles.

sentences.zh: 其犯鹽人應有錢物，並與捉事人充賞者。

translations.literal: The violator's money and goods all go to the arresting party as reward.
translations.idiomatic: The violator's money and goods go to the arresting party as reward.

sentences.zh: 切以兩池禁棘峻阻，不通人行，四面各置場門弓射，分擘鹽池地分居住，並在棘圍裏面，更不別有差遣，只令巡護鹽池。

translations.literal: Strictly speaking, the two pools are fenced with thorns, steep and impassable to travelers; armed guards are posted at field gates on all four sides; residents assigned to salt-pool zones live inside the thorn enclosure, with no other duty assigned, only guarding the salt pools.
translations.idiomatic: The two pools are strictly fenced with thorns and impassable to travelers; armed guards are posted at field gates on all four sides; residents assigned to salt-pool zones live inside the fence with no other duty but guarding the pools.

sentences.zh: 如此後有人偷盜官鹽一斤一兩出池，其犯鹽人並準元敕條流處分，應有隨行錢物並納入官，其捉事人依下項定支優給。

translations.literal: If hereafter anyone steals one jin or one liang of official salt out of the pools, the violator is punished under the original edict articles; traveling money and goods are all turned in to the state; the arresting party receives the generous reward stipulated below.
translations.idiomatic: If anyone later steals even one jin or one liang of official salt from the pools, the violator is punished under the original edict articles; traveling money and goods go to the state; the arresting party receives the stipulated generous reward.

sentences.zh: 若是巡檢、弓射、池場門子，自不專切巡察，致有透漏到棘圍外，被別人捉獲，及有糾告，兼同行反告，官中更不坐罪，陳告人亦依捉事人支賞。

translations.literal: If patrol officers, archers, or pool gatekeepers fail to inspect diligently, allowing leakage outside the thorn enclosure where others capture the thief, or if there is denunciation, and colleagues counter-accuse one another, the government does not punish them further; the accuser also receives reward like an arresting party.
translations.idiomatic: If patrol officers, archers, or pool gatekeepers fail to inspect diligently and leakage reaches outside the fence where others capture or report the thief, or if colleagues counter-accuse one another, the state does not punish them further; the accuser receives the same reward as an arresting party.

sentences.zh: 應有知情偷盜官鹽之人，亦依犯鹽人一例處斷。

translations.literal: All who knowingly assist in stealing official salt are punished like salt violators.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone knowingly assisting theft of official salt is punished like the salt violator.

sentences.zh: 其不知情關連人，臨時酌情定罪。

translations.literal: Unwitting associates are sentenced at discretion on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: Unwitting associates are sentenced at discretion on the spot.

sentences.zh: 所有透漏地分弓射及池場門子，如是透漏出鹽一十斤已下，徒一年半。

translations.literal: For archers and pool gatekeepers in the leaking zone, if ten jin or less of salt leaked out, one and a half years of penal servitude.
translations.idiomatic: Archers and pool gatekeepers in the leaking zone: if ten jin or less of salt leaked out, one and a half years of penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 一十斤已上至二十斤，支賞錢一十千；

translations.literal: from ten jin up to twenty jin, reward money of ten thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: from ten jin up to twenty jin, reward money of ten thousand cash;

sentences.zh: 二十斤已上至五十斤，支賞錢二十千；

translations.literal: from twenty jin up to fifty jin, reward money of twenty thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: from twenty jin up to fifty jin, reward money of twenty thousand cash;

sentences.zh: 五十斤已上至一百斤，支賞錢三十千；

translations.literal: from fifty jin up to one hundred jin, reward money of thirty thousand cash;
translations.idiomatic: from fifty jin up to one hundred jin, reward money of thirty thousand cash;

sentences.zh: 一百斤已上，支賞錢五十千。

translations.literal: one hundred jin or more, reward money of fifty thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: one hundred jin or more, reward money of fifty thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 前項所定奪到鹽法條流，其應屬州府捉獲抵犯之人，便委本州府檢條流科斷訖申奏，別報省司。

translations.literal: For the salt-law articles established above, offenders caught who fall under prefectural jurisdiction shall be sentenced by the local prefecture under the articles and reported upward upon completion; separately notify the provincial office.
translations.idiomatic: Under the salt-law articles established above, offenders caught by prefectures shall be sentenced by the local prefecture under the articles and reported upward; the provincial office shall be separately notified.

sentences.zh: 其屬省院捉到犯鹽之人，幹死刑者，即勘情罪申上，候省司指揮。

translations.literal: Offenders caught by provincial offices who warrant the death penalty shall have circumstances and guilt examined and reported upward, awaiting provincial orders.
translations.idiomatic: Offenders caught by provincial offices who warrant capital punishment shall have circumstances examined and reported upward pending provincial orders.

translations.idiomatic: Those not warranting the maximum penalty shall be sentenced and released by the office under the articles and reported.' )〉

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，敕：「漳河已北州府管界，元是官場糶鹽，今後除城郭草市內，仍舊禁法，其鄉村並許鹽貨通商。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, an edict: 'In prefectural jurisdictions north of the Zhang River, where salt was formerly sold by official monopoly, hereafter except within city walls and grass markets the old prohibition remains in force; in villages salt goods may be freely traded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the third year, an edict: 'In prefectural jurisdictions north of the Zhang River, where salt was formerly sold by official monopoly, the old prohibition remains in force within city walls and grass markets; in villages salt goods may be freely traded.

sentences.zh: 逐處有鹼鹵之地，一任人戶煎煉，興販則不得逾越漳河，入不通商地界。」

translations.literal: Wherever alkali brine lands exist, households may boil freely; in trade they may not cross the Zhang River into non-trade zones.'
translations.idiomatic: Wherever alkali brine lands exist, households may boil freely; trade may not cross the Zhang River into non-trade zones.'

sentences.zh: 〈（《文獻通考》：五年，既取江北諸州，唐主奉表入貢，因白帝以江南無鹵田，願得海陵鹽監南屬以贍軍。

translations.literal: (Comprehensive Examination of Documents: In the fifth year, after the Jiangbei prefectures were taken, the Tang ruler submitted tribute and told the emperor that Jiangnan had no brine fields and requested that the Hailing salt monopoly be placed under the south to support the army.
translations.idiomatic: (Comprehensive Examination of Documents: In the fifth year, after the Jiangbei prefectures were taken, the Tang ruler submitted tribute and told the emperor that Jiangnan had no brine fields and requested the Hailing salt monopoly in the south to support the army.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「海陵在江北難以交居，當別有處分。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: 'Hailing is north of the river and difficult to share jointly; separate arrangements will be made.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'Hailing is north of the river and difficult to share jointly; separate arrangements will be made.'
