translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued to supply Jiangnan two hundred thousand hu of salt annually; soldiers gradually returned.)〉

sentences.zh: 周顯德二年正月，世宗謂侍臣曰：「轉輸之物，向來皆給斗耗，自晉、漢已來，不與支破。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Xiande of Zhou, Emperor Shizong said to his attendants: 'For goods in transport, allowance for handling loss was always granted; since Jin and Han it has not been paid out.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhou Xiande 2, Emperor Shizong told his attendants: 'For transport goods, allowance for handling loss was always granted; since Jin and Han it has not been paid out.

sentences.zh: 倉廩所納新物，尚除省耗，況水路所般，豈無損折？

translations.literal: New goods received in granaries still deduct official handling loss—how can water transport suffer no breakage?
translations.idiomatic: New goods stored in granaries still deduct official handling loss—how can water transport suffer no breakage?

sentences.zh: 起今後每石宜與耗一斗。」

translations.literal: From now on one dou of allowance per shi should be granted.'
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth one dou of allowance per shi shall be granted.'

sentences.zh: 唐天成三年七月，詔曰：「應三京、鄴都、諸道州府鄉村人戶，自今年七月後，於是秋田苗上，每畝納曲錢五文足陌，一任百姓自造私曲，醞酒供家，其錢隨夏秋征納。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Tiancheng of Tang, an edict stated: 'All rural households in the three capitals, Ye capital, and circuit prefectures, from this seventh month forward on autumn field seedling tax, five full-string cash per mu for yeast money, allowing the people to make private yeast and brew wine for home use; the money is collected with summer and autumn taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Tang Tiancheng 3, an edict declared: 'All rural households in the three capitals, Ye capital, and circuit prefectures, from this seventh month forward on autumn field seedling tax, five full-string cash per mu for yeast money, allowing private yeast-making and home wine brewing; the levy is collected with summer and autumn taxes.

sentences.zh: 其京都及諸道州府縣鎮坊界內，應逐年買官曲酒戶，便許自造曲，醞酒貨賣。

translations.literal: In the capital and all circuit prefectures, counties, and market wards, households that annually bought official yeast wine may make their own yeast and brew and sell wine.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital and all circuit prefectures, counties, and market wards, households that annually bought official yeast wine may make their own yeast and brew and sell wine.

sentences.zh: 仍取天成二年正月至年終一年逐戶計算都買曲錢數內，十分只納二分，以充榷酒錢，便從今年七月後，管數征納。

translations.literal: Further, taking from the first month to the end of the second year of Tiancheng one year's total yeast money purchased per household, only two-tenths shall be paid as monopoly wine tax, collected from this seventh month forward according to the assessed amount.
translations.idiomatic: Further, of the total yeast money purchased per household from Tiancheng 2 first month through year end, only two-tenths shall be paid as monopoly wine tax, collected from this seventh month forward.

sentences.zh: 榷酒戶外，其餘諸色人亦許私造酒曲供家，即不得衷私賣酒，如有故違，便即糾察，勒依中等酒戶納榷。

translations.literal: Beyond monopoly wine households, others of all categories may also make private yeast and wine for home use, but may not sell wine privately; if deliberately violated, report and compel payment of monopoly tax like medium wine households.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond monopoly wine households, others may make private yeast and wine for home use but may not sell wine privately; violators shall be reported and compelled to pay monopoly tax like medium wine households.

sentences.zh: 其坊村一任沽賣，不在納榷之限。」

translations.literal: Village markets may sell freely, outside the limits of monopoly payment.'
translations.idiomatic: Village markets may sell freely, outside monopoly limits.

sentences.zh: 時孔循以曲法殺一家於洛陽，或獻此議，以為愛其人，便於國，故行之。

translations.literal: At that time Kong Xun executed a family in Luoyang under the yeast law; someone submitted this proposal, thinking it showed care for the people and served the state, and so it was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Kong Xun had executed a family in Luoyang under the yeast law; someone submitted this proposal, thinking it showed care for the people and served the state, and so it was adopted.

sentences.zh: 長興元年二月，赦書節文：「諸道州府人戶，每秋苗一畝上，元征曲錢五文，今後特放二文，只征三文。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Changxing, amnesty articles: 'Households in circuit prefectures previously paid five cash of yeast money per mu on autumn seedling tax; hereafter two cash are specially remitted, and only three are collected.'
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Changxing 1, amnesty articles: 'Circuit prefecture households previously paid five cash of yeast money per mu on autumn seedling tax; hereafter two cash are remitted, and only three are collected.'

sentences.zh: 二年，詔曰：「酒醴所重，曲糵是須，緣賣價太高，禁條頗峻，士庶因斯而抵犯，刑名由是以滋彰。

translations.literal: In the second year, an edict stated: 'Wine is important and yeast malt is essential; because sale prices were too high and prohibitions too harsh, commoners offend on this account and punishments multiply thereby.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, an edict declared: 'Wine is important and yeast malt essential; because sale prices were too high and prohibitions too harsh, commoners offend and punishments multiply.

sentences.zh: 爰行改革之文，庶息煩苛之政，各隨苗畝，量定稅錢。

translations.literal: Reform articles are now issued, hoping to ease burdensome government; tax money is set according to seedling mu.
translations.idiomatic: Reform articles are issued to ease burdensome government; tax money is set according to seedling mu.

sentences.zh: 訪聞數年已來，雖犯法者稀，而傷民則甚。

translations.literal: It has been learned through inquiry that though violations are fewer in recent years, harm to the people is severe.
translations.idiomatic: Reports indicate that though violations are fewer in recent years, harm to the people is severe.

sentences.zh: 蓋以亂離日久，貧下戶多，才遇升平，便勤稼穡，各務耕田鑿井，孰能枕曲藉糟，既隨例以均攤，遂抱虛而輸納，漸成雕敝，深可憫傷。

translations.literal: This was because disorder and separation had lasted long and poor households were many; they had only just met with peace and at once labored in farming, each striving to plow fields and dig wells—who could recline on yeast and lean on lees? Yet because assessments were spread by rule, they ended up paying in while bearing empty quotas, gradually growing destitute—a matter deeply worthy of compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Disorder had lasted so long and poor households were so numerous that, having only just tasted peace, people threw themselves into farming and dug wells in every field—who had leisure to drink? Yet when levies were spread by rule, they paid taxes on quotas they could not meet and grew steadily poorer—a plight that called for real compassion.

sentences.zh: 況欲致豐財，必除時病，有利之事，方切施行，無名之求，尤宜廢罷，但得日新之理，何辭夕改之嫌。

translations.literal: Moreover, if one wishes to bring about abundant revenue, one must remove the ailments of the age; what is beneficial should be urgently carried out, and nameless exactions should especially be abolished—so long as there is the principle of daily renewal, why shrink from the suspicion of changing course overnight?
translations.idiomatic: To fill the treasury, the abuses of the age must be removed: what helps the realm should be enacted at once, and pointless exactions abolished outright. Where daily improvement is the aim, why fear the charge of changing course overnight?

sentences.zh: 應在京諸道苗畝上所征曲錢等，便從今年夏並放。

translations.literal: The yeast-money and the like levied on field seedlings in the capital and all circuits shall be remitted entirely starting with this year's summer collection.
translations.idiomatic: The yeast levies assessed on field seedlings in the capital and all circuits shall be remitted entirely, beginning with this summer's collection.

sentences.zh: 其曲官中自造，委逐州減舊價一半，於在城撲斷貨賣。

translations.literal: As for the yeast, the government shall make it itself; each prefecture is commissioned to cut the old price in half and sell it by competitive bidding within the walled cities.
translations.idiomatic: The government shall brew the yeast itself; each prefecture shall cut the old price in half and sell it by public bidding within the walled cities.

sentences.zh: 除在城居人不得私造外，鄉村人戶或要供家，一任私造。」

translations.literal: Apart from forbidding urban residents to brew privately, village households that need yeast for household use may brew freely as they wish.'
translations.idiomatic: Urban residents may not brew privately, but village households that need yeast for home use may brew freely.'

sentences.zh: 敕下之日，人甚悅之。

translations.literal: On the day the edict was issued, the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was promulgated, the people rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 周顯德四年七月，詔曰：「諸道州府曲務，今後一依往例，官中禁法賣曲，逐處先置都務，候敕到日，並仰停罷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Xiande of Zhou, an edict stated: 'The yeast offices of the circuits and prefectures shall hereafter follow former practice: the government shall sell yeast under monopoly law. The metropolitan offices previously set up in each place shall all be abolished when this edict arrives.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Zhou Xiande 4 (957), an edict declared: 'Yeast offices in the circuits and prefectures shall return to former practice: the government shall sell yeast under monopoly law. The metropolitan offices set up in each locality shall be abolished when this edict arrives.

sentences.zh: 據見在曲數，準備貨買，兼據年計合，使曲數依時蹋造，候人戶將到價錢，據數給麴，不得賒賣抑配與人。

translations.literal: Based on the current stock of yeast, prepare for sale; also based on the annual estimate, have yeast produced in season; when households bring payment, issue yeast according to the quantity—credit sales and forced allocation to people are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Based on current stocks, prepare yeast for sale; based on the annual estimate, produce yeast on schedule. When households bring payment, issue yeast according to quantity—credit sales and forced allocations are forbidden.
